prompt:
A wide office interior, framed at a medium distance: near enough that the man reads clearly, far enough that there is open space above and to the left of him. A man in his mid-thirties sits at a desk seen from the side, in profile facing to the right, looking down at the open laptop directly in front of him rather than at the viewer. His face is a clear side profile: short curly light brown hair with a little volume on top, a neatly trimmed short beard along the jaw, a straight nose, an athletic build, wearing a light blue button-down shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow.

COMPOSITION, follow this exactly. The man's head and shoulders sit a little left of the centre of the frame, and the laptop sits just right of centre. The top of his head is about a third of the way down the picture, so a clear band of sky and skyline runs above him. The whole top left quarter of the picture is sky, window and distant skyline only, with no part of the man, his head or his chair in it. The desk runs across the lower third of the picture and his hands are on the laptop keyboard about two thirds of the way down.

One open laptop sits on the desk immediately in front of him, close enough that his hands rest on its keyboard, its open screen tilted back and angled toward him so the viewer sees the back of the lid, not the screen. The laptop is the only computer in the picture: no monitors, no second screen, no separate keyboard. His eyeline goes down and forward into the laptop screen, a short close gaze, not a stare into the distance. A red mug, a small stack of books and a potted plant sit further along the desk to his right. His office chair is behind him.

Behind the desk a tall window runs the full width of the frame, looking out over a London skyline of office towers, a dome and two tall construction cranes against a flat blue sky with a few flat white clouds. Calm, wide, cinematic composition with generous flat colour areas.

Ligne claire clear-line comic album illustration. One even unvarying black outline of consistent weight on every single shape. Flat unmodulated colour fills. Absolutely no gradients, no cast shadows, no shading, no hatching, no texture, no photorealism, no 3D rendering. Strict palette: sky blue, paper white, sand ochre, album yellow, sea green, steel blue, and one adventure red used sparingly. IMPORTANT: no text, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks anywhere in the image. No panel border, no black frame, no caption box, no speech balloon, no rounded corners, no letterboxing, no white margin: the illustration bleeds to all four edges of the frame.
